admission.justification: Refusing newly restated reserved headings with an actionable field or operation prevents authors from creating a second competing source of objective, design, requirements or task order while preserving historical text.

applicability: New free-form section headings submitted through task_doc when the heading is reserved for a fixed field or structured block.
conditions: A single case-insensitive heading map supplies the authoring remedy.
Existing matching sections may be edited or removed; grandfathering does not permit an additional newly duplicated reserved heading.
exclusions: Deleting or migrating existing sections solely because their headings are now reserved.
Assuming all future synonyms are already recognized; a new word requires an authored map extension and test.
statement: New free-form sections that case-insensitively restate a fixed field or block are refused from one central heading map with the proper field or operation, while existing sections remain editable and removable.
